propositions: runner.py is exactly 800 LOC at the hard repository cap and has zero headroom for new lines, blocking two dependent stories (2932 and 343b) that must add code

the structured-output execution cluster (_pai_structured, _extract_usage, _warn_if_zeroed_usage, effective_max_tokens, effective_max_iterations, _FAULTY_OUTPUT_SNIPPET_CHARS) forms a genuine call-graph seam with 148 lines of cohesive internal dependencies and no outbound calls to the rest of runner.py except one type annotation

extracting the cluster into a new leaf module structured_run.py reduces runner.py to ~657 LOC (well under 700 target with real headroom) and creates structured_run.py at ~165-175 LOC (above the 100-LOC floor)
structured_run.py must have no runtime import from runner.py (using TYPE_CHECKING guard for RunRequest annotation only) to maintain the leaf rule and avoid circular imports

all test import sites and string-literal monkeypatch targets referencing moved symbols must be enumerated by symbol-reference query and grep, not by eye, to avoid silent patches breaking as in prior stories
